major_cooldowns.name: Combustion
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Hard-cast a spell and activate Combustion just before that cast completes, then use it on cooldown after the opener, delaying only for better overlaps.

major_cooldowns.name: Meteor
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Land Meteor during or near the Combustion window; in single target with Burnout, use it so it lands within about 8-10 seconds of Combustion ending to grow the Ignite bank.

major_cooldowns.name: Time Warp
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Pop Time Warp together with Combustion so the extra haste accelerates your Hot Streak generation during the burst window.

defensives.name: Ice Block
defensives.usage_rule: Full immunity: use it to survive an otherwise lethal hit or a mechanic you cannot outheal, and to clear most damage-over-time debuffs.

defensives.name: Blazing Barrier
defensives.usage_rule: Keep this absorb shield up ahead of predictable damage; it soaks a chunk of incoming damage and knocks back melee attackers.

defensives.name: Mirror Image
defensives.usage_rule: Summon your images before a damage spike to reduce the damage you take while they are active, and to shed threat.

defensives.name: Alter Time
defensives.usage_rule: Cast it before taking a big hit, then let it return you to your earlier health and position when the effect expires.

defensives.name: Greater Invisibility
defensives.usage_rule: Use it to survive a spike or drop aggro; it applies a strong damage reduction and wipes your threat.

defensives.name: Mass Barrier
defensives.usage_rule: Apply Blazing Barrier to yourself and nearby allies just before raid-wide damage lands.

rules.action: Pre-cast a hard-cast Pyroblast before the pull, then cast Fireball with a Fire Blast mid-cast and spend Hot Streak on Pyroblast, running the Double Pyroblast pattern into your first Combustion.
With Firestarter, delay Combustion about 18 seconds until the target drops to 90% health; without Firestarter, still delay it around 8-10 seconds to pre-stack buffs and Fire Blast charges.
Always hard-cast a spell into Combustion and activate Combustion before that cast completes so the cast lands as a guaranteed crit.

rules.description: Convert Heating Up with Fire Blast
rules.action: Use Fire Blast to turn Heating Up into Hot Streak while hardcasting; never sit on capped Fire Blast charges and never spend Fire Blast while Hot Streak is already up.

rules.description: Land Meteor in the Combustion window
rules.action: Time Meteor so it lands during or right after Combustion; in single target with Burnout aim for it to land within about 8-10 seconds of Combustion ending.
Stop spending Fire Blast charges and Pyroclasm stacks when Combustion is about to come up so they are available inside the window.

rules.description: Spend Hot Streak on the right spender
rules.action: Spend Hot Streak on Pyroblast in single target and on Flamestrike at 4 or more targets, but never Flamestrike while Firestarter is active.
If you provide the raid's lust, cast Time Warp together with Combustion so the haste boost lands inside your burst window.

source_summary: Fire Mage has one true major cooldown, Combustion, which is activated at the end of a hardcast so every cast crits and machine-guns Hot Streak Pyroblasts; it is delayed on the pull (about 18 seconds with Firestarter, 8-10 otherwise) and then used on cooldown. Meteor is a minor cooldown paired with Combustion, landing during or just after the window to grow the Ignite bank for Burnout. Time Warp is synced to a Combustion window, and Fire Blast charges plus Pyroclasm stacks are pooled so they are available when Combustion goes out.
